title: Deepness
summary: DEEPNESS, noun 1. Depth; remoteness from the surface in a descending line; interior distance from the surface; profundity. And forthwith they sprung up, because they had no deepness of earth. Matthew

inlines.v: DEEPNESS, noun 1. Depth; remoteness from the surface in a descending line; interior distance from the surface; profundity. And forthwith they sprung up, because they had no deepness of earth. Matthew 13:5 2. Craft; insidiousness.
